entries.reason: ranks 16/17 of coordination/corpus/crash-demand-top.tsv, LOAD-FAIL, class_confirmed against both telegram and session's own trees. apple.objc.inventory() against the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 found no AVCapturePhotoOutput/AVCapturePhotoSettings/AVCaptureResolvedPhotoSettings under any name; AVCaptureStillImageOutput, the class the header documents this API as sitting above, is real and exported. Ladder-walked to 10.0.1 (tools/release-split.lua's own cache-by-cache inventory), not the header's bare 10.0. grep of this tree's own .m files found no orphaned implementation
entries.effect: an AVCaptureStillImageOutput itself (the release's one still capture output), so the session builds, runs and lists it as its own - 6.1.3's session reads its own -outputs while it builds the graph and while a capture runs, and an earlier facade beside the real output made every capture fail with -11800 (measured on an iPad 2); it answers isKindOfClass: AVCaptureStillImageOutput YES, where 10.0's does not; -capturePhotoWithSettings:delegate: captures for real through its own -captureStillImageAsynchronouslyFromConnection:completionHandler: and delivers the real image data through the delegate's -captureOutput:didFinishProcessingPhotoSampleBuffer:previewPhotoSampleBuffer:resolvedSettings:bracketSettings:error: - the iOS 10-era, non-AVCapturePhoto delegate callback telegram's own binary defines alongside the modern one
the output's own availableImageDataCVPixelFormatTypes, the release's answer for its still image output (420f, 420v, 32BGRA on an iPad 2)

entries.reason: rank 628, class_confirmed for telegram; iOS 6's AVCaptureStillImageOutput has no Bayer/Apple ProRAW capture path at all
entries.effect: always an honestly empty array - nothing on this release could ever populate it, not a stub standing in for real RAW support
queries the real AVCaptureDevice behind the output's own connection with the real, iOS-4.0-era -isFlashModeSupported: to build the array for real, not a fixed list

always NO - Apple's own header says this property answers NO unless photoSettingsForSceneMonitoring is set to a non-nil value, and this port carries no scene-monitoring pipeline to ever set it, so NO is the release's own documented default for that state, not a fabricated one

always NO, and setting it to YES throws NSInvalidArgumentException, the same exception real AVCapturePhotoOutput throws when livePhotoCaptureSupported is NO - this release has no motion/video pipeline paired to still capture, so livePhotoCaptureSupported is unconditionally NO here too

real, settable BOOL storage; the release's still image output already captures at the device's full active-format resolution regardless of this flag, so honoring it costs nothing and there is no lower-resolution path it would need to opt out of

entries.reason: rank 100, class_confirmed for both session and telegram
entries.effect: captures for real through the output's own -captureStillImageAsynchronouslyFromConnection:completionHandler:, applying settings.flashMode, settings.autoStillImageStabilizationEnabled (where the release has it, 7.0) and settings.format (a JPEG when it has none) onto the real device/output first, then delivers the real image data through -captureOutput:didFinishProcessingPhotoSampleBuffer:previewPhotoSampleBuffer:resolvedSettings:bracketSettings:error: (with a previewPhotoSampleBuffer when previewPhotoFormat asks for one) and the willBegin/didCapture/didFinishCapture callbacks around it, all only if the delegate responds to them

entries.reason: rank 634, class_confirmed for telegram, needed to make AVCapturePhotoSettings.previewPhotoFormat's own contract (see below) checkable
entries.effect: [32BGRA]: the port draws the preview itself from the captured still, into the format CoreGraphics draws into directly

entries.reason: class-level LOAD-FAIL half of ranks 16/17, part of the same real class carried above
entries.effect: a real, addressable settings object with a real, monotonically-incrementing uniqueID that -capturePhotoWithSettings:delegate: uses to build the AVCaptureResolvedPhotoSettings every delegate callback sees, matching Apple's own documented uniqueID-matching contract
the format dictionary is carried through for real and applied to the underlying AVCaptureStillImageOutput.outputSettings at capture time

kept; at capture it is given to the underlying AVCaptureStillImageOutput's automaticallyEnablesStillImageStabilizationWhenAvailable where the release has it (7.0 on); 6.x has no still image stabilization, and there the setting enables nothing, as on a device without it

kept; at capture a format not in availablePreviewPhotoPixelFormatTypes, or a width without a height or the other way round, raises NSInvalidArgumentException; otherwise the still is decoded (a JPEG through ImageIO's thumbnail, an uncompressed buffer through CoreImage) and drawn into a 32BGRA pixel buffer whose longest side is the larger of the width and height asked, held to the display's, or the display's when none is asked, keeping the photo's aspect ratio, and delivered as previewPhotoSampleBuffer

entries.reason: the object -capturePhotoWithSettings:delegate:'s own delegate callbacks pass to the caller; telegram's own selector cache reads its uniqueID
entries.effect: -uniqueID answers the real int64_t matching the AVCapturePhotoSettings instance the capture request used, per Apple's own documented contract
